page.layout: One column of index entries under a centred title, with a woodcut initial A at the left of the first entries. Above the column, a printed ornament band, then the heading INDEX and a fragment of its subtitle, which continues to the right beyond this part of the page.; One block: a title heading at the top, then one column of index entries running down the page, each entry with its page numbers at the right. main_text.head: INDEX
SECVND operis, ordine A tico digestus.

page.notes: The woodcut initial A and the printed ornament band above the title are decoration, not text. The letter A is given as a list letter. Bsimarus is read with long s as plain s and marked as a doubtful reading in the scan; the reading is uncertain. The entries are transcribed as printed, with their hyphens and page numbers kept. A small printed mark (a flourish or sign) stands before some entries, such as Albia Terentia, Alexander Imp., Alexius Comnenus and Alexius minor; it is not transcribed. The first heading line is set in spaced capitals and is read in the order seen. The entries are in italic and roman type mixed as printed. The top running head is cut off on the left, so only its visible part is given. The scan shows no page number, catchword or signature.
